Tanya Reddy | tanya.reddy422@example.com | +91 9704412335
Ahmedabad, Gujarat

Professional Summary
Results-driven sales leader with a track record of driving pipeline growth and closing high-value B2B deals. Experienced in prospecting, qualification, and account expansion using CRM and sales automation tools. Proven ability to design outreach strategies, manage complex sales cycles, and collaborate with product and operations teams to deliver measurable revenue outcomes.

Technical Skills
B2B Sales, Salesforce, Lead Generation, CRM, Jira

Work Experience

Senior Business Development Manager, Trellis Systems (Aug 2022 - Present)
- Developed and executed B2B Sales strategies targeting mid-market ecommerce and retail clients, resulting in a 38% increase in qualified pipeline year-over-year through structured outreach and account-based campaigns using Salesforce.
- Led Lead Generation efforts across email, LinkedIn, and targeted events, generating 420 new qualified leads in the first 12 months and improving lead-to-opportunity conversion by 22% tracked in CRM.
- Partnered with product and implementation teams via Jira to accelerate time-to-value for pilots, reducing average pilot duration from 9 to 6 weeks and improving pilot-to-paid conversion metrics.

Account Executive, CartNest (Feb 2013 - Jul 2022)
- Managed a portfolio of strategic accounts and executed Lead Generation programs that contributed to sustained revenue growth; implemented targeted campaigns that increased organic inbound leads by 30%.
- Maintained and optimized Salesforce and CRM workflows to improve forecasting accuracy and reduce deal cycle time; introduced standardized opportunity stages and playbooks that improved close rates.
- Coordinated cross-functional issue resolution and feature requests using Jira, ensuring timely delivery of customer-required enhancements and improving customer satisfaction scores.

Education
MBA (Finance), NMIMS
